shortDescription: Manage a decryption rule on PAN-OS.

options.name: action
options.description: The action.

options.name: api_key
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The API key to use instead of generating it using I(username) / I(password).

options.name: audit_comment
options.description: Add an audit comment to the rule being defined. This is only applied if there was a change to the rule.

options.name: decryption_profile
options.description: The decryption profile.

options.name: decryption_type
options.description: The decryption type.

options.name: description
options.description: The rule description.

options.name: destination_addresses
options.description: List of destination addresses. This can be an IP address, an address object/group, etc. When referencing predefined EDLs, use config names of the EDLS not their full names. The config names can be found with the CLI... request system external-list show type predefined-ip name <tab> panw-bulletproof-ip-list   panw-bulletproof-ip-list panw-highrisk-ip-list      panw-highrisk-ip-list panw-known-ip-list         panw-known-ip-list panw-torexit-ip-list       panw-torexit-ip-list

options.name: destination_hip
options.description: The source HIP info.

options.name: destination_zones
options.description: List of destination zones.

options.name: device_group
options.description: (Panorama only) The device group the operation should target.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Rule is disabled or not.

options.name: existing_rule
options.description: If I(location=before) or I(location=after), this option specifies an existing rule name.  The rule being managed by this module will be positioned relative to the value of this parameter. Required if I(location=before) or I(location=after).

options.name: forwarding_profile
options.description: The forwarding profile.

options.name: gathered_filter
options.description: When I(state=gathered). An advanced filtering option to filter results returned from PAN-OS. Refer to the guide discussing I(gathered_filter) for more information.

options.name: group_tag
options.description: PAN-OS 9.0 and above. The group tag.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The IP address or hostname of the PAN-OS device being configured.

options.name: location
options.description: Position to place the rule in.

options.name: log_failed_tls_handshakes
options.description: PAN-OS 10.0 and above. Log failed TLS handshakes.

options.name: log_setting
options.description: PAN-OS 10.0 and above. The log setting.

options.name: log_successful_tls_handshakes
options.description: PAN-OS 10.0 and above. Log successful TLS handshakes.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the rule.

options.name: negate_destination
options.description: Negate the destination addresses.

options.name: negate_source
options.description: Negate the source addresses.

options.name: negate_target
options.description: Applicable for Panorama only. Negate the value for I(target).

options.name: password
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The password to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: port
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The port number to connect to the PAN-OS device on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: rulebase
options.description: The rulebase in which the rule is to exist.  If left unspecified, this defaults to I(rulebase=pre-rulebase) for Panorama.  For NGFW, this is always set to be I(rulebase=rulebase).

options.name: services
options.description: List of services.

options.name: source_addresses
options.description: List of source addresses. This can be an IP address, an address object/group, etc. When referencing predefined EDLs, use config names of the EDLS not their full names. The config names can be found with the CLI... request system external-list show type predefined-ip name <tab> panw-bulletproof-ip-list   panw-bulletproof-ip-list panw-highrisk-ip-list      panw-highrisk-ip-list panw-known-ip-list         panw-known-ip-list panw-torexit-ip-list       panw-torexit-ip-list

options.name: source_hip
options.description: The source HIP info.

options.name: source_users
options.description: The source users.

options.name: source_zones
options.description: List of source zones.

options.name: ssl_certificate
options.description: The SSL certificate.

options.name: state
options.description: The state.

options.name: tags
options.description: The administrative tags.

options.name: target
options.description: Applicable for Panorama only. Apply this rule exclusively to the listed firewall serial numbers.

options.name: url_categories
options.description: List of URL categories. When referencing predefined EDLs, use config names of the EDLS not their full names. The config names can be found with the CLI... request system external-list show type predefined-url name <tab> panw-auth-portal-exclude-list   panw-auth-portal-exclude-list

options.name: username
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The username to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: uuid
options.description: The rule UUID. Note that this is currently more of a read-only field. Usage of the UUID cannot currently take the place of using the rule name as the primary identifier.

options.name: vsys
options.description: The vsys this object belongs to.
